_notes.contigs: Derived, not stored: RFdiffusion v1 needs the TOTAL length of the symmetric assembly, so contigs = 'L-L' with L = protomer_length * n_copies. Storing the total instead of the protomer length is how a C3 config silently becomes a 3x-too-small design.
_notes.mpnn_tying: Derived, not stored: symmetry_residues/symmetry_weights are built from the generated backbones' own chain and residue numbering (see tied_positions in example_pipeline.py). MPNN's homo_oligomer=1 shortcut is avoided — it is broken upstream in fused_mpnn and collides output filenames.
_notes.omit_AA: Cysteine is omitted: an unpaired Cys on a three-fold axis is a disulfide-scrambling liability in a self-assembling particle.
